dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Karibu kwa ajili ya usawa wa kazini. Je, unaweza kutoa maelezo kwa sababu ya uzoefu wako wa kazini?
dialogue.translation: Welcome to the job interview. Can you provide details about your work experience?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Ndiyo, nimekuwa kazini kwa miaka mitano kwa ujumla. Nimefanya kazi kwa pamoja na timu tofauti.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I have been working for five years in general. I have worked together with different teams.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Kwa nini unakikumbuka kuwa na uwezo mkubwa zaidi kazini?
dialogue.translation: Why do you think you have the greatest ability at work?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Kwa sababu ya uwezo wangu wa kufanya kazi kwa bidii na kuwa na uwezo wa kufikiri kwa upande wa timu.
dialogue.translation: Because of my ability to work hard and think from the team's perspective.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Kwa hiyo, unakikumbuka kuwa mtu wa kufanya kazi kwa bidii? Je, unaweza kutoa mfano?
dialogue.translation: Therefore, do you consider yourself a hard worker? Can you give an example?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Ndiyo, kwa mfano, nilipokuwa kazini ya mwisho, niliweza kufanya kazi zaidi kwa sababu ya uwezo wangu.
dialogue.translation: Yes, for example, in my last job, I was able to do more work because of my ability.
